candidates.failure_scenario: GetBlockNodeForPath accepts a VPUverse path and returns UverseNode (nodes.go:1865-1867). Uverse is built with NewPackageNode("uverse", ..., nil) (uverse.go:752), and its consts and types go through Define2 with NameSource{} (uverse.go:756), so `nsrc.NameExpr.Name` at line 2085 dereferences nil. A uverse native reserved with a NameExpr reaches pn.GetDeclForSafe on a nil *FileSet and dereferences fs.Files. keeper.go:1260-1261 builds the same shapes for MsgCall: NewPackageNode("main", "", nil), then mpn.Define("pkg", ...) with a zero NameSource. In every case the next path-keyed caller gets a Go nil-pointer panic where the contract written in this diff promises a nil file. The defect predates the diff, and the diff sweeps this class (names with no declaring file) and misses these two members. The first caller, #6089's assertValidAssignLhs, rejects VPUverse before the call (type_check.go:1051 in that PR), and keeper's synthetic packages evaluate no assignment, so the case is latent today.
